c74object.name: evi_quadfmpm
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Quadrature FM/PM Oscillators by Lionel and Graham
c74object.description:
evi_quadfmpm is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_quadfmpm.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_approx.genexpr
This is a quadrature FM/PM xfading mod/carrier setup, based on LIONEL's patch from: https://cycling74.com/forums/fm-vs-pm-in-gen-unwanted-artifacts-clicks , with additions by Graham Wakefield. I have not been able to ask Lionel's permission. If you are Lionel and you see this, please get in touch.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ pitch, index, fm/pm, fm/pm, mod, car, mod } }

geninlet.name: pitch
geninlet.digest: Controls the pitch of the oscillators in floating point MIDI note values.

geninlet.name: index
geninlet.digest: @default 1.. The FM Index, zero-latched to the modulating oscillator. Index multiplies the amount of Modulator sent to the Carrier. Integer boundaries will sound harmonic, non integer values will sound inharmonic. The greater the index value the more complexity in the resulting signal.

geninlet.name: fm/pm
geninlet.digest: xfade Depth. Inlet 3 controls the range of modulation of FM or PM circuits (depending on the mix position of inlet 4).

geninlet.name: fm/pm
geninlet.digest: xfade Blend. Inlet 4 (along with inlet 3) is used to derive FM and PM amounts. Inlet 4 0..1 mixes between the FM circuit and the PM circuit to modulate the oscillators. This is a brilliant Graham Wakefield idea.

geninlet.name: mod
geninlet.digest: Feedback. Inlet 5 controls the feedback amount in the Modulation oscillator.

geninlet.name: car
geninlet.digest: Feedback. Inlet 6 controls the feedback amount in the Carrier oscillator.

geninlet.name: mod
geninlet.digest: Mult @default 1.. Controls the modulation factor of the oscillators frequency in Hz (derived from the pitch at inlet 1).
